en: Here's today's ultrasound picture.
The baby's healthy and developing well.
Matsuri
Hey!
Big Brother!

The Day the Cosmos Bloomed
Final Chapter
That phone call had me worried.
Huh?
So you came all this way?
Yeah... pretty much.
You never did go see Dad, did you?
The surgery went well, but why don't you at least go see him once?
I don't have the right. I dropped out of college and moved in with Hiro-kun without asking anyone...
I don't think it's a question of having the right.
Did something happen?
Huh?
You've lost a little weight since I last saw you. You look pale, too.
N-no, nothing... I'm fine.
Okay. Well, as long as everything's all right.
Are you leaving already?
Yeah... It'd be awkward running into Hiroki.
U-um, Big Brother...
Oh, you're here again?
CLICK
I was just leaving. Sorry to bother you.
Wait a second. There's something I want to talk about.
Hiro-kun!
Come on, sit back down.
Come on, it's been ages since we had a brother-to-brother chat!
Matsuri, get us some coffee or something!
So, what did you want to talk about?
Well, actually...
Matsuri's pregnant.
What?
Oh, so you hadn't heard?
Thing is...
Honestly, I don't know if it's mine.
She's sleeping with someone else, too.
Oh, I mean, when I say sleeping with him, it's only once in a while. Very occasionally.
Someone connected with the magazine. You know, that kind of...
And this is a crucial time for my career.
You know how it is. In our line of work, scandals are a big no-no.
So I was hoping you could talk to her too--
That's not true!
Huh?
Matsunaga-san... has diabetes, so... um...
It really isn't like that. We just have meals together and talk about back home, or your work, Hiro-kun.
He says you're talented and he wants to help you succeed. But he said if you knew, you'd take him for granted and let it go to your head.
Huh? You think I can just say, 'Oh, okay,' and believe that?
Talk is cheap.
What are you gonna do if you have it and I won't acknowledge it as mine?
Because there's no way in hell I'm acknowledging paternity.
Who's that gonna make happy?
Right? You get it, don't you?
So let's just get this over with...
B-but I...
Enough!
Right now, I don't care whether Matsuri's telling the truth or not.
What matters is that I've realized I'm a complete idiot...
and you're a piece of shit.
We're going home, Matsuri.
Huh...?
Hold on. You don't have to take her back with you.
There's still plenty I need her to do for me.
Right, Matsuri?
You'll keep helping me with my work until I make it, won't you?
Even if you go back to that fucking backwater...
there's absolutely nothing there.
Honestly, living there was hell for me.
Stay in a shithole like that long enough and you'll go crazy.
You're having more fun living here with me, aren't you, Matsuri?
So hurry up and get rid of that baby, and come help me with my work again.
Hiro-kun...
I want to have this baby!
I know you don't want me to, but...
I can't kill this baby.
Damn it, why won't you listen to me, Matsuri?!
Hey.
Huh?
B-Big Brother...
Hah...
My tooth...!
That year you spent living with us was hell for me, too.
You were crude and shameless, and you even went after Matsuri.
Please stop wrecking her life.
We'll figure out what to do about the baby.
Just let Matsuri go.
You've had enough, too, haven't you, Matsuri? Let's go home.
...Yeah.
But I can't just leave Hiro-kun like this.
Big Brother... Let me talk to him one more time.
This time I'll talk things through properly. I won't leave anything unresolved.
I knew Hiro-kun had stopped caring about me a long time ago.
I just kept clinging to him anyway.
I'm sorry, especially after all those awful things I said to you.
I'll come home once we've talked.
Wait for me until then, Big Brother.
All right. But we have to tell Dad and our stepmother what's going on with you two.
Okay?
And then...
...First things first. The hospital.
It's been a while. Not since Dad's funeral, huh?
Matsuri.
Are you sure you're okay? With the pregnancy, I mean.
Yep! The doctor says it's good for me to move around.
PAT PAT
Okay.
I did give the place a bit of a clean yesterday.
CLICK
Wow!
My room's just like it used to be.
Just take what you need. I'll send the bigger stuff over later.
Still, it's sad we're selling this house.
No point keeping a house nobody's going to live in, is there?
I guess not...
How did it go?
I met with Hiro-kun and our stepmother. Just the three of us.
She said she'd do everything she could for me, but...
I don't want to be too much trouble.
In the end, we took care of the paperwork...
That was the last I saw of Hiro-kun.
I'll be fine! I can manage on my own.
I was scared at first, but now I can't wait for the baby to be born.
My stepmother will come check on me now and then,
she says,
so...
You don't have to put on a brave face.
Matsuri...
Why don't you come with me?
The three of us.
Thank you. But I don't want to cause you any more trouble.
When I was living here, I never realized...
how much I was hurting you.
Ever since we met in that garden full of cosmos...
For me...
Big Brother...
We can't... I'll ruin your life again, like I did with Koitabashi-san.
a life without you would hurt more...
Matsuri-chan! More rice over here, please!
Coming! Just a moment, please!
Order in! Special hamburger steak!
You got it!
Ah!
Hey, Ichika! The kitchen's dangerous!
Hey, Matsuri!
Everything okay? Want me to keep an eye on Ichika-chan?
I'm sorry. Please, enjoy your meal.
Ichika-chan's two already? Time flies.
I was surprised when a stylish little hamburger steak place opened in this sleepy fishing town, though.
Oh, it's all thanks to our regulars.
If you weren't married, Matsuri-chan, I'd have you marry my son.
Oh, stop it!
She's right, give it a rest. I'd feel sorry for Matsuri-chan if she married your son.
Wouldn't you agree, sir?
Well, ha ha...
SHIFT...
How's Ichika?
Sound asleep. She was running around all day.
I see...
Come to think of it, you're right.
She hardly cries at night anymore, either.
Something wrong?
Oh, no. Nothing.
Whew!
All done!
Nice work. Want me to get you a drink?
Mmm... better yet...
Give me a big hug...
Big Brooother! ♡
Ah...
Oh, come on. How old are you?
Still in my twenties and in my prime, thank you!
Oh, all right...
Right here.
Come on over.
Since then, we've been hurt so many times...
and hurt other people on our way here.
Even so, if we'd taken even one wrong turn, Ichika would never have been born.
Ichika!
Now I can see it that way.
Ichika?
Did you remember your lunch?
Oh, I forgot!
You can lecture me when I get home!
This is what happens when you don't get up on time.
I knooow!
Hey! I told you not to cut through the restaurant!
Sorry! It's quicker this way!
Ichika, aren't you forgetting to say something?
Oh, come on...
I'm off! Bye, Dad! Bye, Mom!
The years have passed since then...
but whenever the cosmos bloom, I remember everything we've been through.
And I think about...
what lies ahead.
Well, Matsuri, shall we start getting ready to open?
Yeah!
Afterword

Thank you for reading The Day the Cosmos Bloomed. It's been a long road to completion, spanning four years. A lot happened along the way, and there were times when I thought about giving up. But thanks to the readers who supported me, I somehow managed to draw it through to the end. Thank you so much.

The main part of the manga covers roughly ten years, capturing a stretch of Matsuri's and her brother's lives. The characters, including Matsuri-chan, are self-centered, and their views change constantly depending on the situation... I wanted to portray pure love amid all that human messiness. This work has plenty of missteps, but now that it's finished, I can hope to put what I learned from them to use in my next work.

Once again, my sincere thanks to everyone who supported this work and everyone involved in editing it. I hope you'll look forward to my next work, too.

Kei Arai
